content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Start digital

The proposed infrastructure utilizes GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. This combination provides a robust and scalable solution, allowing creators to maintain full ownership and control over their digital commerce stack. With NOWPayments, automatic on-chain crypto payment verification is possible, eliminating the need for intermediaries like Stripe or PayPal.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your sovereign digital commerce stack, you need to prepare your digital products, such as ebooks, courses, or templates. Ensure that your products are ready for sale, and you have a clear understanding of your target audience and marketing strategy. Additionally, familiarize yourself with the technical requirements of the infrastructure, including GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, and NOWPayments. This preparation will streamline the deployment process and ensure a smooth launch.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you will need to integrate NOWPayments with your digital commerce stack. This involves configuring the payment gateway to accept cryptocurrencies and setting up automatic webhook notifications for payment confirmations. You will also need to configure your file delivery system, using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, to ensure seamless product delivery to your customers. By following these steps, you can establish a reliable and efficient payment and delivery pipeline.
Sovereign digital commerce infrastructure empowers creators to maintain full ownership and control.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once you have deployed your sovereign digital commerce stack and set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you are ready to go live. Test your infrastructure by processing a test transaction, ensuring that the payment and delivery pipeline is functioning correctly. With your infrastructure in place, you can now start selling your digital products to customers worldwide, using cryptocurrencies like Bitcoin or USDT. The first transaction is a significant milestone, marking the beginning of your journey as a sovereign digital commerce entrepreneur.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

As your digital commerce business grows, it is essential to scale your infrastructure to meet increasing demand. This involves monitoring your stack's performance, identifying bottlenecks, and optimizing resources as needed. With the Complete Builder Kit ($197), you gain access to all 6 blueprints and 7 templates, providing you with the necessary tools to scale your infrastructure efficiently. By following the scaling playbook, you can ensure that your digital commerce stack remains robust, secure, and performant, supporting your business growth and success.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, you can utilize a sovereign digital commerce stack, leveraging platforms like GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, and NOWPayments. This infrastructure enables you to accept cryptocurrencies and deliver products automatically, eliminating the need for restricted platforms. With Gumroad charging 10% on every sale, compared to NOWPayments' 0.5% fee, the cost savings are significant, retaining $921 at 100 sales per month on a $97 product.

To deploy your sovereign digital commerce stack, start by setting up your GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages hosting. Next, configure your Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script backend logic, and integrate NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification. Then, set up your file delivery system using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Test your infrastructure by processing a test transaction, and finally, go live and start selling your digital products to customers worldwide.
